candidates.change_summary: Change the return statement from `return _paused;` to `return true;` so that paused() always returns true regardless of actual state.
Change the return statement from `return _paused;` to `return false;` so that paused() always returns false regardless of actual state.
Change the return statement from `return _paused;` to `return !_paused;` so that paused() returns the inverse of the actual pause state.
Remove the event emission at the end of updateLRTConfig so observers see no UpdatedLRTConfig event after the call.
Delete the zero-address check so updateLRTConfig can set lrtConfig to address(0), differing from the original which always reverts on zero.
Remove the require check in onlyLRTAdmin so that any caller can invoke updateLRTConfig without being admin.
Skip the zero-address check and event emission entirely; updateLRTConfig only updates the internal pointer, which changes the set of visible events after a call.
Remove the entire updateLRTConfig function; after a call to the (now non-existent) updateLRTConfig it must revert differently than before, so the observable state differs (revert vs success).
Remove the assignment of maxNodeDelegatorCount so it stays at its default value 0
Replace the initializer modifier with an empty modifier that does nothing, allowing initialize to be called again and reset maxNodeDelegatorCount
